Message TS: 1791629737.945699
to <@U03GRE909MJ|Lion cho (조중현,Cho Chung Hyun)>
Idea: AI money copilot, like having your own financial advisor

Sharing an idea I've had for a few months. Honest feedback welcome.

*[Problem]*
Your bank already knows everything about your money: salary, bills, habits. But the app only shows a balance and a list of transactions. It never answers the real question: can I afford this and still be fine until payday? So people guess, overspend, and stress.

*[Idea]*
An AI copilot that knows your money and talks to you like a personal advisor:
1. Understand: spending by category, recurring bills, payday, where you overspend.
2. Ask: plain-language questions instead of checking balances.
3. Warn early: "At this pace, you run short 4 days before payday."

*[Example]*
Me: "My camera lens broke. Can I afford a $500 lens?"
AI: "Not safely today. Payday is the 25th, 18 days away. After bills due before then ($430), your normal spending (~$450) and a $100 safety cushion, you have about $370 free. Buy it on the 25th, or buy now and spend about $7/day less until payday."

*[How it's built]*
The math is code, not the LLM: balance, upcoming bills, spending forecast, payday → safe-to-spend. The LLM only explains the result, and every answer shows its numbers.

*[Two ways to launch]*
1. Inside the bank: the bank licenses it per active user; customers get it free in their bank app. Live data, highest trust, and data never leaves the bank. But banks buy slowly.
2. Standalone app: works with any bank, no bank deal needed. Data comes in without typing: bank SMS alerts (Android, with permission), monthly e-statement upload, quick-add for cash. Fast to launch, but we have to earn daily use.
Proposal: launch the app first to get proof, then take the usage numbers to banks. The app becomes the demo that sells the bank version.

*[Evidence]*
• Standalone works: Cleo, an AI money app, passed $300M ARR (Dec 2025).
• Banks want it: Bank of America's Erica has 24.6M active users (+23% YoY), and over half of its 3.6B interactions were proactive insights. But the customer version still isn't GenAI (Aug 2026).
• Pakistan is opening: aik Connect launched an open banking gateway on Raast (Aug 2026), and SBP has licensed digital retail banks (Easypaisa Bank first).
My bet: US giants build this in-house. Banks in Pakistan and Africa will license it once they see it working.
